messages.subject: DT Format Issue on Tab Change
parts:
I have an automated application that runs through different scenarios, then switches tabs and runs through more scenarios, then switches back to the original tab to start over. When I switch back to the original tab to start over, the datatable is mis-formatted. It corrects itself on the next scenario, but the initial scenario after the tab switch back is always mis-formatted.

Mis-formatted:


Properly formatted:


What can I do to correct this format issue when it app switches back to the original tab?

Thanks,
Logan

messages.author: ae36205664915f39
messages.subject: Re: DT Format Issue on Tab Change
parts:
Yihui-
Sorry, I mistakenly updated the shiny to the dev version...DT was already at the dev version 1.39.


Joe-
Below is a watered-down version of my renderDT call that does not include the slicing/filtering of the dataset based on user input before passing it to datatable().

DT::renderDataTable({                
                   datatable(finalDataset,                     #create dataTable using the finalDataset
                             extensions = 'Scroller',          #use the scroller extension for better table viewing
                             filter = 'top',                   #add filters at the bottom of the page
                             rownames = FALSE,
                             selection="none",                 #turn off row selection
                             options = list(order = list(list(1, 'desc')), #order entries by newest to oldest date
                                            searchCols = list(NULL,NULL,quicksearch$data),
                                            language = list(search = ''),     #change title of search bar to ""
                                            deferRender = TRUE,               #increase performance by only rendering what is on screen
                                            scrollY = 400,                    #the height of the scroll table enabled by the Scroller extension
                                            scrollCollapse = TRUE,            #allows the scroll window to shrink to dataset size if smaller than scrollY
                                            columnDefs = list(list(width = '125px', targets = c(0)),list(targets = c(1),searchable = FALSE)), #sets the width of the Source column
                                            autowidth = TRUE,                 #autowidth the other columns
                                            searchHighlight=TRUE,             #highlight the keywords in the searches. futher customization in css files
                                            lengthMenu = c(15,50,100),        #options of how many results are initially returned
                                            pageLength = 15,                  #default length of the above options
                                            server = TRUE                     #enable server side processing for better performance
                             )) %>% formatStyle("Source",fontWeight = 'bold',color=styleEqual(brks,clrs)) #add colors to the different Sources
                 }) #end of render datatable
